description: This file contains the implementation of the 'git stash' command, including subcommands like list, show, drop, pop, apply, branch, store, push, save, export, import, and related internal logic for managing stash entries, such as creating, applying, dropping, exporting, and importing stash commits, as well as handling related data structures and configurations.

classes.name: stash_info
classes.description: Data structure holding information about a stash entry, including commit IDs for working state, base, index, untracked, and the associated trees.

classes.name: stash_entry_data
classes.description: Data structure used for collecting stash entries during export, including repository reference and list of stash commits.

methods.name: void free_stash_info(struct stash_info * info)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a stash_info structure.

methods.name: int check_stash_topology(struct repository * r,struct commit * stash)
methods.description: Verifies the topology of a stash commit, ensuring it has the correct parent structure.

methods.name: void assert_stash_like(struct stash_info * info,const char * revision)
methods.description: Asserts that the given revision has stash-like characteristics, i.e., proper reference and tree structure.

methods.name: int parse_stash_revision(struct strbuf * revision,const char * commit,int quiet)
methods.description: Parses a revision string into a stash revision, handling special cases.

methods.name: int get_stash_info(struct stash_info * info,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Retrieves stash information based on provided revision or reference.

methods.name: int do_clear_stash(void)
methods.description: Deletes the stash reference.

methods.name: int clear_stash(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handler for the 'git stash clear' command.

methods.name: int reset_tree(struct object_id * i_tree,int update,int reset)
methods.description: Resets a tree to a specified state, updating the index accordingly.

methods.name: int diff_tree_binary(struct strbuf * out,struct object_id * w_commit)
methods.description: Generates binary diffs between trees.

methods.name: int apply_cached(struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Applies cached changes from the index.

methods.name: int reset_head(void)
methods.description: Resets HEAD to a specific state.

methods.name: int is_path_a_directory(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory, following lstat semantics.

methods.name: void add_diff_to_buf(struct diff_queue_struct * q,struct diff_options * options UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Callback to append diff file paths to a buffer.

methods.name: int restore_untracked(struct object_id * u_tree)
methods.description: Restores untracked files from a stash.

methods.name: int do_apply_stash(const char * prefix,struct stash_info * info,int index,int quiet)
methods.description: Main logic to apply a stash entry, including merging and restoring states.

methods.name: int apply_stash(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handler for 'git stash apply' command.

methods.name: int reject_reflog_ent(const char * refname UNUSED,struct object_id * ooid UNUSED,struct object_id * noid UNUSED,const char * email UNUSED,timestamp_t timestamp UNUSED,int tz UNUSED,const char * message UNUSED,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Rejects reflog entries (used as callback).

methods.name: int reflog_is_empty(const char * refname)
methods.description: Checks if the reflog is empty for a given reference.

methods.name: int do_drop_stash(struct stash_info * info,int quiet)
methods.description: Drops a stash entry from reflog and deletes the reference if empty.

methods.name: int get_stash_info_assert(struct stash_info * info,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Retrieves stash info and asserts it is a valid stash reference.

methods.name: int drop_stash(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handler for 'git stash drop'.

methods.name: int pop_stash(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handler for 'git stash pop', applying and then dropping the stash.

methods.name: int branch_stash(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Creates a new branch from a stash.

methods.name: int list_stash(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Lists stash entries.

methods.name: int git_stash_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Reads stash-related configuration settings.

methods.name: void diff_include_untracked(const struct stash_info * info,struct diff_options * diff_opt)
methods.description: Includes untracked files in diff for stash show.

methods.name: int show_stash(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Displays the contents of a stash entry.

methods.name: int do_store_stash(const struct object_id * w_commit,const char * stash_msg,int quiet)
methods.description: Stores a stash object in the refs/stash reference.

methods.name: store_stash
methods.description: Handler for 'git stash store'.

methods.name: void add_pathspecs(struct strvec * args,const struct pathspec * ps)
methods.description: Adds pathspec items to argument list.

methods.name: int get_untracked_files(const struct pathspec * ps,int include_untracked,struct strbuf * untracked_files)
methods.description: Gets list of untracked files matching pathspecs.

methods.name: int check_changes_tracked_files(const struct pathspec * ps)
methods.description: Checks for tracked file changes compared to HEAD.

methods.name: int check_changes(const struct pathspec * ps,int include_untracked,struct strbuf * untracked_files)
methods.description: Checks for tracked and untracked file changes.

methods.name: int save_untracked_files(struct stash_info * info,struct strbuf * msg,struct strbuf files)
methods.description: Saves untracked files into a commit for stash.

methods.name: stash_staged
methods.description: Stores staged changes.

methods.name: stash_patch
methods.description: Creates a patch of working directory changes.

methods.name: stash_working_tree
methods.description: Stores the current working tree state.

methods.description: Creates a new stash, including index, working directory, and untracked files.

methods.description: Core logic for 'git stash push' or 'save', including handling index, untracked, staged, and patch flags.

methods.description: Handler for 'git stash save'.
